title: Real S2 reference bundle G0 from actual runs, and E01-E05 edits generalized to any base bundle
objective: Build the S2 reference bundle from real executions (adapter.make_receipt over the integrated world, predicates, rulers and twins) with a ledger run inventory, and make every E01-E05 bundle edit a function of a base bundle so T020 can apply it to the real G0.
problem: evidence_cases.g0_dicts() is synthetic: trace bytes are fixture strings and outcomes are the contract's expected values (T014 receipt). The T020 matrix must run the consumer over receipts produced from real runs at a recorded commit. Build s2_bundle.build_g0(commit, ledger) -> (dicts, traces, inventory, manifest) covering draft B B9's G0: CALIBRATION(STANDARD); for REG, PKTD, LAGD: BOUNDS, RETENTION, ERASE, PRESERVE, CHANNEL, RESTART and OBSERVER for the observers B9 names (REG/PKTD: NULL, BOOKKEEP; LAGD: NULL); TWIN_EQ(REG, REG-ONEHOT). Each launch charged to the ledger (launch_kind TOP_LEVEL for the build, or one row per receipt with node_id per V7). Then refactor evidence_cases so each E01-E05 edit takes a base (dicts, traces, inventory) and returns a Case; the existing synthetic tests must keep passing unchanged in outcome.
non_goals: No registration with the store (Palamedes requests it from Aporia at T020)
Do not write the T020 driver or compare against the expected table (T020)
evidence_required: test: build_g0 receipts validate, bind under G-BIND against their own manifest, G-INV PASS on the produced inventory, G-RECOMP PASS
test: every edit function applied to the real G0 produces the E-case's bundle and the synthetic E01-E05 tests still pass

acceptance.condition: real G0 consistent under the consumer gates; edits generalized; prior tests green
